items.prompt: Style: a wide 16:9 in-game screenshot of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition running a careful graphics mod, taken in photo mode with the interface hidden: the game's own Nordic architecture, materials and props, as a player standing there would see them. Realistic game lighting with real darkness: firelight and lantern light fall off within a few meters and the rest of the frame lies in deep blue night shadow. Restrained natural color: cold blue-gray night, the warm amber of fire as the one accent. Surfaces as the game has them: rough hewn logs, carved beam ends, wolf and bear furs, black iron, mossy stone, old snow. The scene: One locked-off wide shot from a covered timber porch in a Riverwood-style Nordic village, looking across a river to a sawmill and its waterwheel. No humans.. Foreground: rough porch planks, carved beam ends, the sleeping hound on its fur and the brazier. Midground: dark river, low stony bank and a log-built sawmill with its waterwheel in view. Background: snowy mountains beneath a clear sky and northern lights. Also in view: flat stony riverbank below the porch; open river beside the sawmill; broad timber porch step; lit iron lantern beneath the eaves. deep blue night shadow, with restrained amber firelight and lantern light falling off within a few meters. Locked-off camera at eye level, wide 16:9 composition with a clear foreground, midground and background. Leave open, uncluttered areas around the light sources, the windows and the animal so they can be animated. No people anywhere: no pedestrians or silhouettes outside, no portraits, posters or statues of people. No other animals besides the one pet: no birds, insects, snails or frogs anywhere (small creatures are animated in afterwards). No lightning bolts. Things that move are animated afterwards, so do not paint them frozen: no visible steam or smoke plumes, no water drops hanging from edges and no streams of dripping water; surfaces may look wet. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no user interface. It must look like deliberate work by an artist, never generic AI fantasy art: no glossy or plastic surfaces, no sparkles or glitter, no bokeh, no lens flare, no bloom halos, no glowing particles, sparks or dust motes, no god rays, no wet reflections full of glints, no teal-and-orange grading, no HDR detail on every surface, no smooth airbrushed gradients, no epic fantasy-poster drama. Leave large areas simple and dark; put the detail only where the eye should go.
